summary: Comprehensive testing of ROSCA new features completed. All 25 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all new pages and flows working correctly. RBAC system properly restricts admin access to superadmin users only.
passed_tests: Landing page loads at /landing with all sections (hero, features, how-it-works, benefits, CTA, footer)
Landing page has 6 feature cards and 4 how-it-works steps
Register page shows 3-step flow (details, math challenge, email verification)
Math challenge API /api/auth/math-challenge returns valid challenge with num1, num2, operation
Registration init API /api/auth/register/init validates data and sends verification email
Registration init rejects short passwords and duplicate emails
Registration verify API /api/auth/register/verify validates codes
Forgot password page at /forgot-password works with 2-step flow
Forgot password API /api/auth/forgot-password sends reset code (returns 200 for security)
Reset password API /api/auth/reset-password validates tokens and updates password
Login page has forgot password link
Superadmin login works with admin@rosca.com credentials
Admin Dashboard at /admin accessible for superadmin
Admin Dashboard shows Users tab with user management table
Admin Dashboard shows CMS tab with content management
Navigation shows Admin link for superadmin users only
User management API /api/admin/users lists all users (superadmin only)
User role update API /api/admin/users/{id}/role validates roles
CMS content API /api/cms/content CRUD operations work
CMS content is publicly readable but only superadmin can create/update/delete
RBAC correctly denies moderator access to admin endpoints (403)
Legacy register endpoint still works for backward compatibility
Change password API validates current password
critical_code_review_comments: AgentMail email sending may fail in test environment - verification codes are logged to backend when email fails (this is expected behavior)
ESLint warnings for missing useEffect dependencies in AdminDashboard.jsx, GroupDetail.jsx, Register.jsx - minor, not affecting functionality
seed_data_creation: Superadmin user admin@rosca.com with password admin123 was pre-created by main agent
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (landing page, 3-step registration with math captcha and email verification, forgot/reset password, admin dashboard with user management and CMS, RBAC) are fully functional. AgentMail integration is real but may not send emails in test environment - codes are logged to backend. The /landing route is the public landing page, / is the protected dashboard.
